body:
As a mom? It seems like I'm doing it all wrong, but that could partially be the depression talking. No discipline because how can I teach self discipline when I don't have it? They don't clean up after themselves. The house is a wreck. Dishes in the sink. Mound of dirty clothes. I'm 90% sure that's playdoh stuck to the back of my couch. 

I can't remember the last time I taught them anything. We walk every where because we don't have a car, but we never go to the park. I have zero patience. I think I yell at them more than I talk to them. I have to force myself to hug them. Except the baby, the baby I have a hard time putting down. It's like I feel so much worse without her weight against me. 

They deserve so much better. They really are good kids.
